current_evidence: Redbridge's 'Validation requirements' page links only this document, titled 'LPAR Aug 2026 (PDF 8.4MB)', and the PDF ('Local and National Planning Application Requirement List') is dated August 2026 in its text.

issues.detail: Fire Safety (non-major), a Planning Fire Safety Strategy (PFSS) or Reasonable Exception Statement (RES), is not captured. It applies to all non-major applications including householder, yet the workbook's Householder row says '(none)'.
issues.evidence: LPAR Aug 2026, Fire Safety (non-major): 'Non-major developments, including householder applications'

issues.detail: Photographs of Site is a local requirement for all applications but is not captured, so the Householder, Advertisement, LBC and other rows wrongly show '(none)'.
issues.evidence: LPAR Aug 2026, Photographs of Site: 'All applications'

issues.detail: Several site-specific local requirements that apply at any scale are missing. Arboriculture Impact Statement / Tree Survey: all applications where trees in or next to the site may be affected. Basement Impact Assessment or Construction Method Statement for Basements: all applications involving basement development. Lighting Assessment: major applications with external lighting, and all applications with floodlighting. Flues and Vents Assessment: any application proposing plant, flues, ventilation, extraction or air conditioning in detail; Grokbot's 'Ventilation / Extraction' row has only content text. HMO Management Plan: conversions or changes of use to HMOs. Community Use Statement: loss of a community use. Student Housing Report: student accommodation. Open Space, Sport and Recreation Assessment: Green Belt, MOL or playing pitches.
issues.evidence: LPAR Aug 2026, Basement Impact Assessment: 'All applications that involve basement development'; Arboriculture: 'All applications where trees within or adjacent to the site may be affected by the development.'

issues.detail: Many major-application requirements are missing. Affordable Housing Statement: major residential of 10+ units or 1,000 sq m. Affordable and Managed Workspace Management Plan: major office or commercial mixed use. Air Quality Assessment: all majors, with exceptions. Air Quality Positive Statement: GLA-referable EIA-category majors. BREEAM Assessment: all non-residential majors. Circular Economy Statement and Whole Life-Cycle Carbon Assessment: GLA-referable majors. Community Involvement Statement, Planning Statement and Green Infrastructure / Urban Greening Factor: all majors. Ecological and Biodiversity Assessment: majors on or near designated sites, rivers, brownfield or open space, or where protected species may be present. Health Impact Assessment: majors of 150+ dwellings. Landscaping Plan: majors over 100 units. Transport Impact Assessment and Green Travel Plan: majors over 50 homes or 1,000 sq m commercial, and non-majors with significant transport effects. Waste / Site Waste Management Plan / Service Delivery Plan: major and non-major change of use or new residential units. Sequential Test (Town Centre): main town centre uses.
issues.evidence: LPAR Aug 2026, Planning Statement / Community Involvement Statement / Energy and Sustainability: 'All major applications.'

issues.detail: The tab_items are drawing advice, submission rules, fees and guidance-link fragments, not requirements. Examples: 'Annotation may be very useful.'; scale bar advice; 'strongly recommended' CIL floor-area measurements; single-page PDF rules; the invalid-application admin charges (£235 major, £140 non-major commercial or new residential, £70 other) and the refund note ending '17 3.'; redaction notes; and the link fragments 'Air Quality Neutral (AQN) guidance | London City Hall ... Validation Requirement:', 'Guidance London Mayor's Air Quality Positive Guidance ...' and 'LP 31 – Basement Development, Redbridge Housing Design Guide SPD: ... See also:'.
issues.evidence: LPAR: 'Administration charges (£235 for major applications, £140 for non-major commercial/new residential unit applications, £70 for all other applications) will be applied on invalidation'

issues.detail: 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is advice to seek pre-app or a private consultant, not a validation requirement. 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' is built from Block Plan wording ('access arrangements and all public rights of way'); the LPAR has no separate highways or visibility splay requirement.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: 'Please seek additional guidance from the Council via our pre-application advice services'

issues.detail: Most trigger excerpts are guidance links, content notes or fragments instead of the LPAR's 'Applications requiring this' text. BNG gives Environment Act text and link fragments. Contaminated Land gives CL:AIRE library text (actual: sensitive end use on land at risk of contamination). Drainage/SuDS gives SFRA link lists (actual: all majors plus smaller schemes meeting flood-risk criteria). Fire Statement gives 'Exception s regarding Fire Statements paragraph 6 ... Applications requir ing this:' (actual: all majors). Heritage Statement starts 'health-wellbeing strategy2017_2021.pdf' and is cut off (actual: anything that directly affects, or affects the setting of, a listed building, registered park/garden, non-designated heritage asset or conservation area). Sequential Test gives 'necessary) the Sequential Test, and;'. S106 Heads of Terms gives a redaction note (actual: all majors). Noise, Energy, Archaeology and Flood Risk give content text, not triggers.
issues.evidence: LPAR: Archaeological Assessment - 'All applications within Archaeological Priority Areas likely to affect important archaeological remains.'

issues.detail: Some triggers leave out the scale thresholds that define them. Daylight/Sunlight is given as 'recalculated if ... significant/material change' (actual: all major applications). Tall buildings is given as 'should include the variety of impacts' (actual: majors of 18m+ and/or over 6 storeys). CIL omits 'new dwelling and/or 100 sq m (GIA) or more'. Because the LPAR is organised by scale (Minor / Major / GLA-referable), not by application type, the missing 'major' condition makes these rows look like they apply to every full application.
issues.evidence: LPAR, Daylight and Sunlight Assessment: 'All major applications.'

issues.detail: Habitats Regulations Assessment / UU (SAMMS and SANGS contributions) is placed under Full planning with the fragment 'Regulations Screening and Appropriate Assessment ...'. The LPAR applies it to non-major residential proposals within 0-6.2km of Epping Forest SAC, explicitly including prior approval change of use to residential, and excludes majors. The 'Change of use - prior approval' row lists only national floor plans/elevations and misses the UU.
issues.evidence: LPAR: 'All non-major residential proposals within 0-6.2km Zone of Influence of Epping Forest Special Area of Conservation (SAC)'; also lists 'Prior approval change of use to residential units'

issues.detail: About 20 items carry the note 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', and Outline and Reserved matters are '(none)', although the LPAR's major-application items apply equally to outline schemes. Under Listed building consent only 'Schedule of works' is listed; it is really a sub-item of the Heritage Statement, which, along with the Design and Access Statement the LPAR applies to listed building consents, is not shown for LBC.
issues.evidence: LPAR, Heritage Statement row: 'Requirement for a Structural Impact Assessment – Schedule of Works for Listed buildings.'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Redbridge LPAR (August 2026). The extraction misses most of its 42 local requirements, including Fire Safety (non-major, incl. householder) and Photographs for all applications. tab_items are fees and link fragments, and many triggers are guidance URLs or content notes that drop the 'major applications' thresholds.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
